newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli warplanes rocket eastern Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli warplanes rocket eastern Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli warplanes fired rockets on Saturday into the eastern sector of the Syrian-policed Bekaa Valley, security sources said.
There was no immediate word on casualties in the air assault.
The Lebanese security sources said Israeli F16 jets fired two rockets near the village of Nabi Sheet, some five km (three miles) from the Lebanese-Syrian borders.
A day earlier, Israeli warplanes attacked Palestinian bases south of Beirut after Katyusha rockets slammed into northern Israel.
The Moslem militant Hizbollah group, fighting to oust Israeli troops from a south Lebanon occupation zone, denied firing the rockets.
